Full suite is green — **262 tests, 0 failures**.

## Summary

The requirement is that creating an owner must be rejected with HTTP 409 when the telephone number already belongs to any other owner. The codebase already had a duplicate-owner mechanism (`DuplicateOwnerException` → 409 via the exception advice), but it keyed on last name + telephone. I changed it to key on telephone alone across all owners.

Changes in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
- `addOwner` now calls `isDuplicateTelephone(owner)` and throws with a telephone-specific message.
- Replaced `isDuplicateOwner` (searched by last name, matched last name + telephone) with `isDuplicateTelephone`, which scans `findAllOwners()` and matches on telephone only.

Also updated the `DuplicateOwnerException` javadoc to describe the telephone rule, and added a test `createOwnerDuplicateTelephoneDifferentLastNameReturnsConflict` verifying that a matching telephone with a different last name returns 409. All existing owner tests (including "same last name, different telephone succeeds") still pass under the stricter rule.

## Summary

The requirement is that creating an owner must be rejected with HTTP 409 when the telephone number already belongs to any other owner. The codebase already had a duplicate-owner mechanism (`DuplicateOwnerException` → 409 via the exception advice), but it keyed on last name + telephone. I changed it to key on telephone alone across all owners.

Changes in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
- `addOwner` now calls `isDuplicateTelephone(owner)` and throws with a telephone-specific message.
- Replaced `isDuplicateOwner` (searched by last name, matched last name + telephone) with `isDuplicateTelephone`, which scans `findAllOwners()` and matches on telephone only.

Also updated the `DuplicateOwnerException` javadoc to describe the telephone rule, and added a test `createOwnerDuplicateTelephoneDifferentLastNameReturnsConflict` verifying that a matching telephone with a different last name returns 409. All existing owner tests (including "same last name, different telephone succeeds") still pass under the stricter rule.
